citations.assessment: Opening participant is written Abba bar Tachlifa and the next line writes Acha bar Tachlifa. The host is Acha son of Rav Ika and the local sage is Acha bar Yaakov.
They had already begun according honor to the elder, the first explanation. The second gives his exceptional status [10].
Elazar reports the dream. Rava draws the inference that this is a favorable time, and the assembled people pray in the plural.
Rashi explicitly interprets the term as a calf one-third grown and rejects third-born. Preserve Heilprin’s neutral expression or give this as a named interpretation.
The alternative reason is his exceptional standing. The preceding line preserves the first explanation.
